text:
anne.sales: Quick kickoff — AcmeRetail wants a short POC next week. primary asks: streaming SDK install, live function-calls, and structured JSON output for order-normalization. also they want an estimate for dedicated capacity pricing. can we confirm blockers?
jordan.presales: +1. They need EU region, SSO/SAML + KMS, and IP allowlist. will be production-ish traffic (~30 TPS sustained) during peak test.
sam.eng: For streaming SDK we can use the node websocket client, should be straightforward. main gotcha is handshake: their proxy mutates the upgrade headers sometimes. we can add the ?handshake=v2 param to the client. example: `wss://inference.redwood.ai/v1/stream?key=<key>&handshake=v2`
karla.security: For KMS we'll need their KMS type (AWS KMS vs customer HSM). Private deployment requires offline KMS or bring-your-own-key config. also SOC2 checklist will need data retention and access controls answered.
anne.sales: pricing question: short trial then potential reserved Dedicated pool. ballpark cost for ~30 TPS with 8k avg token length?
sam.eng: Ballpark: if we use a mid-tier dedicated pool (8x A10G equiv) you're looking at monthly commit in the low-mid 5k range for test scale, but streaming and long context could raise throughput needs. I can model cost more precisely with a sample workload.
jordan.presales: Action items: (1) sam — sample workload cost calc, (2) karla — fill SOC2/KMS answers, (3) devex — quick runbook + example app for their proxy.
devex-bot: Created runbook draft: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/presales/acmeretail-stream-poc (internal) — contains handshake tips, curl/ws snippets, and structured-output schema.
sam.eng: Quick snippet for function-calls in streaming (Node):
```js
const ws = new WebSocket(url);
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'invoke', fn: 'normalize_order', args: {order_raw: raw}})));
ws.on('message', (m) => console.log('stream chunk', m));
```
note: use `accept: application/stream+json` and set `x-rw-region: eu-west-1` header for residency.
karla.security: Security Q: do we persist raw PII? if they want no retention we can enable ephemeral mode on Private or Dedicated with zero-trace logging. need their legal contact to sign DPA.
anne.sales: They asked about structured output schema — they want a compact normalized order JSON: `order_id, line_items[{sku, qty, price_cents}], total_cents, customer_id, shipping_address{country, postal}`. can we guarantee adherence?
sam.eng: We can enforce with function-call style and schema contract. recommend `response_format: {type: 'json_schema', schema_url: 'https://internal.redwood/schemas/order-normalize-v1.json'}` in the request. we'll also include a fallback text if validation fails.
jordan.presales: Any enterprise blockers for onprem or VPC?
karla.security: Main blockers: SAML metadata exchange, IP allowlist for their egress, and KMS workflow. Also audit logging retention needs confirmation — default 90d, enterprise can extend.
anne.sales: Ok, running list to send them in the kickoff email. Jordan — want me to book a 30m call with tech + security + their infra?
jordan.presales: Yes please, slot Tues 10am CET. I'll invite Sam and Karla. Also please attach the runbook + cost sketch.
sam.eng: I'll mock a synthetic workload and post numbers by EOD tomorrow.
karla.security: I'll start the SOC2 checklist draft and note the KMS options.
anne.sales: Thanks. If handshake fails we should try bypassing proxy with an agent container in their VPC (we've done that before). I'll note that as contingency. :thumbsup:
devex-bot: Runbook updated with contingency notes and sample `curl`/ws commands.
